author: Animan
description:
The best animated anime fights of all time — ranked. From Jujutsu Kaisen's Shibuya Incident and Demon Slayer's Rengoku vs Akaza to Bleach TYBW, overpowered MC, these are the most beautifully animated anime action scenes ever made (pure sakuga, absolute cinema).
We're counting down 10 anime fight scenes with outstanding animation quality — the sakuga-drenched, "built different" moments from MAPPA, Ufotable, Bones, Wit Studio, Trigger, Pierrot, and David Production that prove animation isn't just movement, it's emotion.
